entries.description:
Activity
: Landform Explorers – Around the World!
Students participated in an
atlas-based activity
where they identified
10 geographical locations
on the world map, named the continents in which they are located and classified the respective landforms.
Objective
: To develop atlas-reading and map-pointing skills, enhance geographical awareness and help students understand the distribution of different landforms across the world.
